_what: External citations. This is the ONE hand-recorded data file on the site, and it exists because an external count is a citation, not a measurement: nothing in this repository can derive how many skills SkillsBench indexes.
_rule: Every entry carries the URL it was read from and the date it was read. scripts/site-data.mjs copies these into docs/data/stats.json with `from` pointing back here, so a figure on the homepage still leads a reader to a source they can check.

skillsbench.title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
skillsbench._note: arXiv 2602.12670. Cited to the paper, not to a repository: the counts are the paper's, and a link to a repo nobody checked would be the unsourced figure this file exists to retire.
